digest.component_or_area: LLM provider abstraction and parity measurement
propositions: Bedrock must be measured against the parity bar before becoming a first-class provider; the measurement requires a provider-parity harness modeled on the proven fidelity_spot_eval precedent.

The parity corpus pools 30 gold-labeled cases across 15 eval specs (15 block and 15 advisory) to satisfy MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20, excluding agentic disposable-store reviewers where resolve_gate_config does not apply.

Both Bedrock inference-profile ids (sonnet and opus) are invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1; opus refuses temperature=0 on both providers symmetrically via the existing supports_temperature override, with zero sampling rejections across 360 case-runs.

Payload and tool parity hold across both class slots: system prompt, messages, tools and max_tokens are byte-identical; only the model_id field differs; 8 envelope differences are legitimate and enumerated.

Provider routing is clean: zero non-Bedrock calls occur on 84/84 v2 case-runs on both slots, verified by REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally and enforced by context-copied gate_config under concurrency.

The decision-level and verdict-agreement figures recorded are informational evidence (comparing two different models is out of epic scope); Bedrock clears the bar under the operator-defined scope: same payloads, same tools, provider-clean routing, and both slots measurable.
